svg.title: HotelnGo Go Capsule IBM Plex Sans logo for dark backgrounds
svg.desc: White IBM Plex Sans Hoteln wordmark paired with a bright GO capsule and forward arrow.
svg.metadata: Hoteln uses IBM Plex Sans Bold. GO uses Barlow Semi Condensed ExtraBold. Embedded Latin-subset WOFF2 fonts are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
